origin: Original configured origin; no observed date substituted or invented
individual_law: Conditional independent Bernoulli with exp(-shared_cohort_hazard*actual_record_exposure); unresolved fate retains shared MNAR and wet-proxy shifts. B1 cell-specific shifts affect unresolved component only, not association branches.
carrier: Reaggregate 64 ancestral cohorts using exact integer survivor counts and survivor-weighted squared projected component diameter. Component baseline RMS and shared measurement/prior-size noise retained; only per-record exposure replaces its pooled mean. No invented wet positions or individual baseline diameters.
association: Unchanged two-branch unresolved-identity law, using existing individual dates
fit: Original per-record hazard likelihood and pooled-hazard prior center retained and separately audited. No external outcome fitting.

inventory.DP: First nonempty cohort in each component, at most first 20 sorted stem IDs

state_comparison.coupling: Same registered draw identities and parameter/shift consumption; changed Bernoulli consumption means no exact common-uniform pairing claim
state_comparison.summaries: All draws, absolute local maximum and q95; averages alone cannot establish robustness

future_comparisons: Deferred to separately frozen R0-R4 factorial after mathematical and reconstruction audits; no downstream inference before this phase completes
selection: All recorded components and all preregistered draw/family cells retained; absent or invalid dates are explicit obstruction, never imputed as observations
